_doc: ADR-031 (D-047 rulings 12-14; ledger §10; D-043 A1-A5). The nine ratified Ages, the five Age-milestone categories, the per-Age ENTRY requirements and the Age-surge emphases.

PROVISIONAL CONTENT. Ledger §27 defers the FINAL milestone thresholds to the Director. The lists below are real and data-driven - every fact reads state an owning system already publishes - but each threshold is a plausible provisional value, not a historical calibration. Tune freely (D-006); the loader validates every reference.

AGE IS COMPUTED STATE (law 4). A polity's Age changes only when (a) its entry requirements evaluate true over published state AND (b) the polity issues an AdvanceAge order. No date, era band or turn number appears anywhere in this file.

entry: the requirements for ENTERING this Age from the one before. core: every core milestone must hold. supporting: at least supportingRequired of them must hold, and the held ones must span at least minCategories distinct categories (D-043 A2: no single easy category can carry an Age).

fact kinds (owner in parentheses - the system whose published table the fact reads): research = any listed node completed (ResearchSystem: ResearchCompleted); research_count = completed nodes in a tree (ResearchSystem); population = total people in controlled settlements (DemographicsSystem: Buckets); settlements = controlled settlements (Controls: worldgen founding + ColonizationSystem); structures = completed structures, optionally of one project (ConstructionSystem: Structures); good_stock = summed stock of one good over controlled settlements (Production/Consumption/Trade/Housing via the Ledger: GoodStocks); class_active = settlements where a class is active (ClassMobilitySystem: ClassStates); trade_volume = whole units moved last turn into or out of controlled settlements (TradeArbitrageSystem: TradeFlows); dwellings = housing stock (HousingSystem: Housing); formations = military formations owned, optionally of one unit family (AgeTransitionSystem: MilitaryUnits - REAL unit state, never researched technology, ledger §10.4).

surges: the player (or AI) chooses ONE emphasis when advancing (D-047 ruling 14, the Civ VI dedication pattern adapted). The choice and its start turn are stored. NO NUMERIC EFFECT IS IMPLEMENTED: the formula, magnitude and duration are deferred (ledger §10.5, §27; D-043 DD-14). The fields below are the qualitative description the UI shows.
foundingAgeBasis: D-044 T7: no node is complete at founding - the reading of the Director's 'the game begins in the Stone Age'. Founding is therefore A1 Prehistoric / Stone Age.

core.name: Cultivated cereals
core.description: The civilization has learned deliberate cereal cultivation.

supporting.name: Fired pottery
supporting.description: Open-fired pottery for storage and cooking.

supporting.name: Managed flocks
supporting.description: Selective flock breeding of sheep and goats.

supporting.name: Grain surplus
supporting.description: A stored grain surplus well beyond the founding stores (about twice the canonical founding endowment of 12 x 6,000).

supporting.name: Settled villages
supporting.description: A substantial housing stock of permanent dwellings.

supporting.name: Growing population
supporting.description: The civilization supports a larger population than its founders.

supporting.name: Communal store
supporting.description: At least one granary has been built.

supporting.name: Standing warband
supporting.description: The civilization maintains at least one military formation.

core.name: Bronze metallurgy
core.description: Arsenical or tin bronze is known.

supporting.name: Record keeping
supporting.description: Proto-writing or token accounting records obligations.

supporting.name: Bronze in use
supporting.description: Bronze is actually produced and held, not merely known.

supporting.name: Specialist craftsmen
supporting.description: An artisan class has emerged in at least one settlement.

supporting.name: Exchange network
supporting.description: Goods move between the civilization's settlements.

supporting.name: Dense population
supporting.description: A population well beyond the Neolithic founding.

supporting.name: Organized force
supporting.description: The civilization maintains a military formation.

supporting.name: Tool stock
supporting.description: A working stock of tools across the settlements.

supporting.name: Expansion
supporting.description: The civilization has grown to more settlements.

supporting.name: Standing army
supporting.description: The civilization maintains a military formation.

supporting.name: Paved roads
supporting.description: The paved-road infrastructure class is known.

supporting.name: Imperial trade
supporting.description: A large volume of goods moves through the civilization.

supporting.name: Commercial finance
supporting.description: Double-entry bookkeeping or bills of exchange.

supporting.name: Retained forces
supporting.description: The civilization maintains a military formation.

supporting.name: Commercial economy
supporting.description: A large volume of goods moves through the civilization.

supporting.name: Standing forces
supporting.description: The civilization maintains a military formation.

supporting.name: Broad knowledge base
supporting.description: A broad base of completed technology.

supporting.name: Modern forces
supporting.description: The civilization maintains a military formation.

supporting.name: Modern knowledge base
supporting.description: A very broad base of completed technology.

supporting.name: Mass trade
supporting.description: A very large volume of goods moves through the civilization.

supporting.name: Modern military
supporting.description: The civilization maintains a military formation.

surges.name: Age of Learning
surges.description: The transition is channelled into scholarship: new knowledge is absorbed and recorded while the Age's ideas are fresh.

surges.name: Age of Works
surges.description: The transition is channelled into building: the new Age's methods are applied to construction and infrastructure.
surges.expectedEffect: temporary acceleration of construction and path building

surges.name: Age of Plenty
surges.description: The transition is channelled into the land: new practices raise what fields, herds and waters yield.
surges.expectedEffect: temporary rise in food production and population productivity

surges.name: Age of Commerce
surges.description: The transition is channelled into exchange: markets and routes absorb the new Age's opportunities.
surges.expectedEffect: temporary rise in trade and economic activity

surges.name: Age of Industry
surges.description: The transition is channelled into making: crafts and extraction adopt the new Age's techniques.
surges.expectedEffect: temporary rise in crafting and resource extraction

surges.name: Age of Arms
surges.description: The transition is channelled into the military: forces are reorganized around the new Age's methods.
surges.expectedEffect: temporary acceleration of military production and training
downstreamSystems: military (not yet simulated: D-011 battle layer deferred)

surgeShape: temporary: begins on Age entry, ramps toward a peak, holds, then tapers toward roughly half the peak (ledger §10.5, D-043 A5). Formula, magnitude and duration are DEFERRED (ledger §27, DD-14): no numeric effect is applied by any system.
